subject: Workplace Skills
title: Mapping Stakeholder Interests
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Mapping Stakeholder Interests.

hook.text: A project manager launched a tool without asking the sales team. They boycotted it on day one.

buildup.text: Every initiative affects different groups differently. Some win, some lose, some feel threatened.

discovery.text: Before proposing anything, map who benefits, who's harmed, who decides, and who can block progress.

twist.text: The biggest risk is often the silent stakeholder you didn't consult, not the vocal critic.

climax.text: Engage resisters early. Their concerns, addressed upfront, become your strongest defense later.

punchline.text: Map the interests. Engage the skeptics first.

quiz.question: What's the biggest risk in stakeholder management?
options: The silent stakeholder you didn't consult
Spending too much time on stakeholder analysis
